name: Capacite Infraprojects Ltd
title: Capacite Infraprojects Ltd - 540710 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7% to INR629 crore with EBITDA down 3% on a INR10 crore commodity provision; management leans on a 20% FY27 growth guide that rests on delayed project starts and a labour recovery.

capex.quote: For the full year, the target is INR193 crores. The CapEx done in Q1 is INR79 -- sorry, INR52.2 crores.

triggers.label: Q1 revenue growth 7% vs 20% guide
triggers.quote: Revenue for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR629 crores, up by 7% as compared to INR589 crores in Q1 FY '26.

triggers.label: Commodity provision INR10 crore added
triggers.quote: the company has, therefore, taken an additional provision of INR10 crores in the current quarter.

triggers.label: Gross debt rose to INR522 crore
triggers.quote: The total gross debt is INR522 crores. I have given a commentary during the last conference call that on a yearly basis, it will reduce.

triggers.label: Order inflow guide INR4,500-5,000 crore kept
triggers.quote: FY '27 order inflow target is between INR4,500 crores to INR5,000 crores. Orders booked so far in FY '27 stands at INR1,071 crores

guidance.quote: Our guidance is 20% year -on-year, all right, and we are well on track to do that.
FY '27 order inflow target is between INR4,500 crores to INR5,000 crores.
I had given a figure last time of approximately INR600 crores for the full year.
For the full year, the target is INR193 crores.
Our 8 quarters net debt -free target is well on track.

prior_guidance_check.quote: The performance was impacted by workmen shortages and factors beyond the control of the company.
you last time guided for capex for FY '25 to be -- for '27 to be around INR165 crores

red_flags.label: Revenue growth decelerating 22% to 12% to 7%
red_flags.quote: We were at 22% in FY '25 and then we were at 12% in FY '26, and we are currently at 7%.

red_flags.label: Contract assets plus debtors ~78% of revenue
red_flags.quote: contract assets plus debtors for our company stands at approximately 78% to the top line as on 31st March.

red_flags.label: Gross debt rose QoQ
red_flags.quote: This has only increased because approximately INR150 crores of payments got shifted by 10 days

red_flags.label: Promoter share pledge still outstanding
red_flags.quote: The promoter share pledge has been reduced from 85.5 lakh shares on an absolute basis as on 31st March 2026 to 50 lakh shares currently.

red_flags.label: Provision reversal depends on indices
red_flags.quote: It again depends on the inflation index and not on the food or ret ail or wholesale price.

evasions.quote: Absolute number, we can always discuss offline because I don't have it ready in front of me.
as a company policy, since we don't declare L1 position on the stock exchanges, I will not be able to comment any further
I will not be able to take names.

summary.headline: Capacite Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 7% to INR629 crore, but EBITDA fell 3% to INR99 crore after a INR10 crore commodity provision.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 7% YoY to INR629 crore while EBITDA moderated 3% to INR99 crore, with margin down to 15.7% from 17.2%. PAT fell to INR40 crore (6.2% margin) from INR47 crore, impacted by an additional INR10 crore provision for non-ferrous commodity price escalation not yet covered by government indices. Management attributed the weak execution to labour shortages (workforce fell to about 7,000 in June, roughly 30% short) and a delayed IIT Bombay start, and said labour is now fully in place. Order book stood at INR13,535 crore, with FY27 inflow guidance of INR4,500-5,000 crore and INR1,071 crore booked so far.

financial_highlights.change: Q4 FY26 had a similar INR10 crore provision
Up on ~INR150 crore receipts shifted by 10 days

segments.name: MHADA BDD Worli (via TCC, 35% stake)
segments.commentary: Total TCC order about INR17,000 crore incl. escalation; Capacite share of 34 rehab buildings backlog estimated at INR7,500-8,000 crore x 35%. Management targets about INR20 crore per month in Q2, with about INR60 crore for the quarter and INR75 crore+ in each of Q3 and Q4.

segments.name: CIDCO Maha Awas housing
segments.commentary: Handed over 2 of 7 locations; balance 50% of 16.2m sq ft expected to be handed over Q2-Q3. Remaining backlog about INR2,000-2,500 crore incl. escalation, with FY27 revenue target about INR600 crore; revenue expected to step up from Q3. Extension to March 2028 received.

segments.name: NBCC
segments.commentary: Revenue ramp from under INR15 crore per month last year to about INR60 crore per month from the current quarter; certified bills about INR300 crore, and profit recognition has started after crossing the 20% threshold.

segments.name: IIT Bombay (INR550 crore)
segments.commentary: Start delayed from Q4 FY26 to Q2 FY27 due to tree-cutting permissions; cost about INR65-70 crore of Q1-Q2 revenue. First building handed over and execution started.

segments.name: Signature Global
segments.commentary: Target about INR22 crore monthly revenue; Q1 dipped on labour shortage, now more than 1,000 workers on site, with improvement expected from July-August.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance of about 20% YoY, reiterated; management says Q2 July was strong and needs about INR850 crore+ quarterly run rate in Q3 and Q4.
FY27 order inflow target INR4,500-5,000 crore; management expects to exceed 50% of the upper end in Q2 alone.
Additional INR10 crore provision not expected in Q2; Q3 provision reversal possible if escalation indices catch up, though management gave a disclaimer.
Net debt-free target within 8 quarters reiterated; working capital days expected to fall 25-30 in FY27 after 43-day reduction in FY26.
Term loan repayments of INR102 crore in FY27; debt may rise by INR45-50 crore net due to equipment purchases.
Promoter share pledge reduced from 85.5 lakh shares (31 March 2026) to 50 lakh; full release targeted by fiscal year-end.
capex_capacity: FY27 capex target INR193 crore: INR121 crore aluminium formwork and extrusions, INR56 crore plant and machinery (high-speed lifts, heavier cranes for composite buildings), INR5.43 crore IT including SAP go-live in Q3 FY27.
Q1 FY27 capex was INR52.2 crore.
Management says more than 15 super-high-rise buildings are under execution.
demand_pricing: Order book INR13,535 crore; 62% of book is 40-plus-storey towers per analyst; public 55%, private 45%.
Q1 FY27 order inflow was entirely private; Q2 expected to be equal public and private. Identified public pipeline of INR22,000 crore and private pipeline of INR5,000 crore for Q2-Q3.
Non-ferrous commodity inflation (aluminium up 35-40%) not yet reflected in CPWD/government price variation indices; CPWD DSR escalation about 14% vs raw material up about 40%.
Price variation on order book about 28% per management; NBCC escalation about 6%.
Contract assets plus debtors about 78% of revenue as of 31 March 2026 vs peers 56-65 days; down from about 120% post-COVID.
Working capital days cut 43 in FY26; cash from operations rose from about INR50 crore to about INR250 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Why is order book not converting into revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited IIT Bombay delay (INR65-70 crore Q1-Q2 revenue lost), NBCC ramp, and labour shortage; said execution had been about INR8,000-9,000 crore of the INR13,500 crore book and expects revenue to peak in Q3-Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Will the INR20 crore provision reverse?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said a substantial portion could reverse in Q3-Q4 if inflation indices catch up, but disclaimed that it depends on indices, not market prices; no further provision expected in Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Status of L1 positions (CIDCO Maha Awas, Chennai Metro commercial complex)?
qa_highlights.answer: Company does not declare L1 positions; said it hopes to convert both into orders within the current month, citing public-domain information.

qa_highlights.question: Contract assets versus peers and exit target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said contract assets plus debtors are about 78% of revenue vs peers 56-65 days; aims for leadership by March 2028 and a positive surprise by March 2027. Absolute contract asset figures to be shared offline.

qa_highlights.question: Capex increase from INR165 crore to INR193 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Increase is driven by expected orders in Q2, including more formwork, high-speed lifts and cranes for composite projects; term debt may rise by INR45-50 crore net.

qa_highlights.question: Gross debt rise to INR522 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Increase due to about INR150 crore of receipts shifted by 10 days, collected in the current month; management says annual gross and net debt will decline.
